content.short: Quick Intel is a Web3 security solution providing token data to help assess consumer security.
content.description: Quick Intel provides essential data and information about tokens to address consumer security concerns. By presenting this information in a clear, digestible format, it helps users feel more confident in the tokens they invest in. On any supported chain, simply paste the token address and hit scan to display the relevant details, giving you fast, reliable visibility into each token's basic facts. This straightforward workflow supports more informed choices and safer investing decisions.
content.meta: Quick Intel provides token data to support consumer security. Discover Quick Intel and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
